title: ImpactHO: Importance-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Multi-User Edge LLM Handover
selection_reason: Turns token-level KV importance into communication savings for edge handover under constrained backhaul; achieves over 93.7% average accuracy in a 500 ms transfer window and 98.2-99.5% of a clairvoyant upper bound.
